lead.event: Rupiah reaches a record low as the IHSG declines
lead.headline: Rupiah hits record low of Rp18,288 as IHSG declines
lead.blurb: The IHSG is 41% below its peak, with pressure compounded by expected US Federal Reserve rate hikes and a potential MSCI reclassification that could trigger US$10 billion in outflows. Alamtri Resources and Indo Tambangraya are cited for natural hedging, trading at 0.77 and 0.76 times book value, respectively. Pharmaceuticals and automotive assembly face margin pressure from dollar-priced imported inputs.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ENRG secures a US$220 million Deutsche Bank facility for HighPeak investment
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ENRG secures up to US$220 million Deutsche Bank facility for HighPeak investment
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Energi Mega Persada signed the facility on 13 November to fund its US$200 million participation in newly issued HighPeak convertible preferred shares. They may convert into common shares at US$9.5 each, and HighPeak will use the funds to strengthen its capital structure, including refinancing US$1.17 billion in debt.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BMAS plans a Rp1 trillion rights issue with KVF as standby buyer
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMAS plans Rp1 trillion rights issue with KVF as standby buyer
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: KBank Indonesia plans to issue 2.87 billion shares at Rp350 each, equal to 13.70% of its paid-up capital. KVF will exercise 2.54 billion rights and buy all shares left unsubscribed. Rights trading and exercise run from 27 November to 3 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GMFI plans a rights issue of up to 22.03 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GMFI plans rights issue to raise about Rp1.05 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: GMF Asia says shareholders who do not subscribe could face dilution of up to 15%. The plan requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 8 December 2026.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: GMFI plans to raise approximately Rp1.05 trillion through the rights issue.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Harum Energy ends its share buyback program early
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: HRUM ends Rp120 billion share buyback early
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Harum Energy ended the program effective 17 November, citing capital-market rules and a restructuring plan being prepared by its controlling shareholders. Announced on 25 September, the buyback was set to cover up to 111 million shares, about 0.82% of issued and paid-up capital, through 24 December. The board said another buyback may be conducted under applicable rules.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: kept: 1 new articles, no new fact

deals_control.event: CNI plans to acquire 6.685 billion INET shares
deals_control.headline: CNI plans to buy 6.685 billion INET shares
deals_control.blurb: CNI, a subsidiary of Era Media Sejahtera, plans to buy the shares from Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara at Rp300 each, after approval at Era Media Sejahtera’s 9 November RUPSLB. Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara will remain INET’s controller.

other.event: MMIX shares hit the auto-rejection bottom after a sharp decline
other.headline: MMIX hits lower price limit after 6.81% fall to Rp356
other.blurb: Multi Medika Internasional had fallen for 12 consecutive trading days since 2 November, losing more than 55% from Rp795 on 30 October. Sell queues at Rp356 reached about 154,186 lots by 09:22 WIB on 17 November.

market_structure_policy.event: ERAA joins the IDX LQ45 index
market_structure_policy.headline: ERAA joins LQ45 with a 0.25% index weight
market_structure_policy.blurb: Erajaya's inclusion runs from 18 November to 29 January 2027. Panin Sekuritas analyst Elandry Pratama sees it as a positive catalyst for visibility and institutional exposure, and sets a 12-month target of Rp600–Rp650 with a speculative buy on weakness recommendation.

earnings_guidance.event: CGS downgrades BBYB and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: CGS downgrades BBYB to hold and cuts target price to Rp162
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Neo Commerce's loan-at-risk ratio rose to 14.6%, while cost of credit reached 16.8% for the nine-month period. CGS values the stock at 0.4 times 2027 price to book after cutting its 2026-2028 EPS projections by 5.7%-18.2%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: BRI reports Q3 loan and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI reports 14.5% loan and 16.8% profit growth in Q3
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net profit reached Rp48.2 trillion. Third-party funds rose 12% to Rp1,651 trillion, while the bank’s capital adequacy ratio stood at 23%.
